title: Floods
text:
A flood happens when a lot of water covers land that is normally dry. Heavy rain is one common cause. Rivers can also rise after snow melts in spring. Floods can damage roads, houses, and farms.

Scientists watch the weather closely to warn people early. When a warning is given, people should move to higher ground. They should take important documents and medicine with them. Children should always stay with an adult.

questions.text: What is one common cause of a flood?
What should people take with them when a warning is given?
Why do scientists watch the weather closely?
options: To help people get warnings early

questions.text: What can you infer about children during a flood warning?
options: They are not in any danger.
They should go down to the river.
